name: Maharashtra Ration Card / Food Supply (MahaFood)
description: Maharashtra ration card issuance and PDS entitlements under NFSA/state schemes.
eligibility: Maharashtra households meeting NFSA/state poverty criteria.
benefits: Subsidised foodgrains via PDS; priority/APL/BPL categories.
application_mode: Online (maha food portal) and rationing offices / CSC
application_steps: Apply via Maharashtra food supply portal / CSC.
office_locator_info: District Supply Offices; Fair Price Shops.

faq.q: How do I add a member to my ration card?
faq.a: Apply for modification at the rationing office / portal with proof.

ai_summary: Maharashtra ration cards (MahaFood) provide subsidised PDS foodgrains under NFSA/state schemes.
ai_explanation: The Maharashtra Food, Civil Supplies department issues ration cards classifying households (Priority/APL/BPL) for subsidised foodgrains through Fair Price Shops under NFSA and state schemes. Aadhaar-seeded cards enable DBT/portability.
